spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (उभति)
To fill; also उम्भ.

pron. m. and dual only, (उभौ)
Both.

pron. (sing. and plu. only,) (-यः-ये)
Both.
E.
उभ and य from या to obtain, affix ड.

ind.
On both sides.
E.
उभय both, and तसि aff.

mf. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Having a double row of teeth, (man, animal, &c.)
E.
उभयतस् and दत् for दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Looking either way, two-faced.
E.
उमयतस् and मुख face.

ind.
In both places, on both sides.
E.
उभय and त्रल् aff.

ind.
In both ways.
E.
उभय and थाल् aff.

ind.
Both days, the day past and to come.
E.
उभय both, द्युस् affix; or with एद्युस् affix, उभयेद्युस्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Applicable to two purposes.
2 Taking two shares or parts.
n. (-रं)
A medicine that acts in two ways, as an emetic and a purge.
E.
उभय, भाग a part, and हर what takes.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Serving two masters, being in the pay of both.
E.
उभय and वेतन wages.

m. (-वः)
A dilemma.
E.
उभय both, (conclusions,) सम्भव production.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Agreed to or accepted mutually, or on both sides.
E.
उभय and अनुमत assented to.

ind.
For a double object, (as for prosperity in earth and happiness in heaven.)
E.
उभय and अर्थ an object.
